en: Vintage black‑and‑white street view of a European town. A broad, unpaved or lightly paved road runs into the distance, lined with substantial late‑19th‑/early‑20th‑century buildings. On the left are ornate multi‑story townhouses or civic buildings with decorative roofs; on the right is a large, simpler building signed as a hotel. People walk along the sidewalks and a few horse‑drawn vehicles are on the street. Printed captions at the bottom identify the scene as Bahnhofstrasse in Wurzen, and a printer's line notes Brück & Sohn, Meissen.
